desc.en: A reduced MAME 0.278 core for Capcom CPS1/CPS2, SNK Neo Geo and IGS PGM arcade games. Other arcade systems are not included. Use ROM sets compatible with MAME 0.278; some games also require a parent set, BIOS or key files. Compatibility and save state support vary by game.
desc.zh: 基于 MAME 0.278 的精简街机核心，包含 Capcom CPS1/CPS2、SNK Neo Geo 和 IGS PGM，不包含其他街机系统。请使用与 MAME 0.278 兼容的 ROM；部分游戏还需要主 ROM、BIOS 或密钥文件。具体兼容性和即时存档支持因游戏而异。
